Package io.github.jabrena.juno.ir

package io.github.jabrena.juno.ir
Juno's own intermediate representation: a non-SSA, block-structured form that lowering produces from JVM bytecode, optimize transforms, and backend consumes to generate assembly.

A IrProgram holds every reachable IrMethod, each a sequence of IrBasicBlocks of IrInstructions ending in an IrTerminator. Every operand-stack push/pop and local variable becomes an explicit, typed Value — a symbolic virtual register produced by exactly one instruction — carrying a JunoType. BinaryOp, FloatBinaryOp, UnaryOp, and Condition name the operations an instruction can perform; ArrayDeclaration and ArrayElementType describe a method's hoisted local arrays and their storage width.
